subject: ClearStream: follow-up & lock demo + dedicated sizing call
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@clearstream.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearStream discovery — next steps (demo + dedicated sizing)

Hi Emma — really enjoyed the discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Scope: you mentioned two primary inference surfaces — a near-real-time recommendations API (~peak traffic during daytime hours) and a nightly batch embed job. For the demo/tech deep dive we should focus on the realtime path and throughput/latency targets.
- Primary ask for the sizing call: an estimate of 95th percentile latency SLO (target & maximum), expected peak concurrent requests (or RPS), typical request token length, and whether responses are streamed.

Proposed next meeting (technical deep dive + dedicated capacity sizing):
- Option A: Wed Sep 22, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Thu Sep 23, 14:00–15:00 PT

If neither works send a couple of windows that do. For the agenda we'll cover: workload profile, demo of the Redwood serving runtime, initial dedicated pool sizing estimate, and a mutual action item list (load profile, data residency note, required SLAs).

Also looping in Monica (Solutions) who will run the sizing portion. Monica — heads up on traffic profile details below from the call: Emma said peak daytime load concentrated M–F, and the client expects a 95th latency target of ~120ms for simple recs (they said current infra averages 180–220ms).

Emma — could you share a quick CSV with the hourly request distribution or peak RPS if available? If you prefer, ops@clearstream.io can drop the file.

Thanks — I’ll hold both slots tentatively until we lock one.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Clarke <emma@clearstream.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@clearstream.io
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearStream discovery — next steps (demo + dedicated sizing)

Thanks Rishi — great session today, appreciate the concise recap. Wed Sep 22 10:00 PT works for the core team (me + one infra engineer).

Attaching a small load snapshot we pulled (hourly counts for last 7 days) — the CSV is called clearstream-load-profile.csv. A few notes:
- Peak sustained RPS: ~250 for a 30–60 minute window (spikes to ~350 occasionally).
- Typical payloads: request tokens ~40–80, responses ~30–100.
- Streaming: not for recommendations; we do have a separate streaming endpoint for analytics which isn’t in scope for the sizing call.
- Target: our product team wants 95th <= 120ms for the recommendations endpoint; we can tolerate a higher 99th during black swan events.

If you need anything else ahead of Wed let me know.

—Emma
Head of Platform
ClearStream Analytics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@clearstream.io>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearStream discovery — next steps (demo + dedicated sizing)

Thanks Emma — got the CSV and quick read-through looks good. Hi all — I’ll run the technical deep dive and sizing exercise on Wed. Proposed agenda (30–45 min tech deep dive, 15–30 min sizing run-through):

1) Quick architecture map of how you’d route requests to Redwood (region/egress notes)
2) Live demo of warm KV cache and how we handle batching for short requests
3) Walk through the CSV and translate to simulated arrival curves
4) Sizing estimate: GPU pool delta for 95th=120ms, fallback plan, and next actions 

Prep items for ClearStream:
- Confirm whether rate-limits are bursty (we’ll need the peak burst value if available)
- Flag any PII or HIPAA-regulated content — that affects private deployment options

Rishi/Monica — I’ll prepare an initial sizing spreadsheet and leave room in the call for adjustments.

See you Wed 10:00 PT.

Cheers,
Karthik
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Clarke <emma@clearstream.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@clearstream.io
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearStream discovery — next steps (demo + dedicated sizing)

Perfect — Wed 10:00 PT is locked. ops@clearstream.io has added the CSV to the ticket (see attached in this thread). A couple quick clarifications ahead of the call: 

- Burstiness: yes — we can see short bursts up to ~350 RPS but those are rare; the 250 number is what we provision for.
- PII: no customer PII in the stream, only device IDs and hashed identifiers.

Also tagging our SRE (ops@clearstream.io) — they may join for the architecture discussion. Looking forward to the demo and the sizing estimate.

Thanks,
Emma
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal - ClearStream action items before Wed

Quick internal note:
- Karthik: please build the initial sizing model using the attached CSV (use 250 sustained / 350 burst, tokens 40–80). Aim to produce two sizing options (cost-optimized and latency-optimized) we can present live.
- Monica: prepare a short slide that explains our fallback policies (model variant fallback + region routing) and the SLA tradeoffs.
- I’ll confirm HubSpot deal and send the invite with the Zoom link; add the HubSpot deal link to the calendar invite.

I’ll CC Emma once we have the invite.

Rishi
